dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.fail.1: Not yet. Rest, fight out there and come back when you are ready.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.fail.2: Bankai crushes those who are not ready. Grow stronger and challenge me again.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.fail.3: Fell down? Get up. That's what training is for.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.fail.4: "Too weak, King. Come back when you can look me in the eye."
...You are not my soul. I have nothing to say to one who does not carry my blade.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hint.0: You still can't hear me properly... Fight more with the blade and come back.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hint.1: It is not yet time to know my name.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hint.2: You are not yet strong enough to release me.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hint.3: Kidō and the blade must walk together. Train both.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hint.4: The Bankai demands far more of you.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hollow.1: ...? Wait. There is someone else in here. Something WHITE moves behind me...
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hollow.2: "Hey, King... %s. All this power and you still leave it sleeping with me? If you can't use it, I WILL."
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hollow.3: It took my place! Defeat the Inner Hollow — show who rules this soul!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.hollow_w: "Heh... So the King learned to ride the horse. For now."
The Hollow retreats, %s. Its power is now yours: sweep your hand across your face and the MASK forms.
Use the mask and the Cero with care. If it grows too much... your whole body becomes Hollow.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.1: The wind in here has changed, %s. You've been fighting well.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.2: When you hesitate, it rains in this world. Don't let it rain.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.3: A blade without purpose is just a piece of iron. Remember yours, %s.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.4: Numbered Kidō is like a prayer: the higher the number, the steadier the soul must be.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.5: I sense Hollows out there. When you find them, show no mercy.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.6: Sit for a while, %s. Even captains need silence.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.idle.exi: When you want to go back, meditate again.
%s... There is one last technique. It is not a strike: it is you becoming the Getsuga itself.
All your spiritual strength in a single blade of darkness. No moon, no sky. It cuts everything.
But the price is losing that power for a long while. Use it only when nothing else remains.
This is my final teaching: Mugetsu.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.named.1: Listen well, because I will only say it once... My name is %s.
Everything that exists has a name written on it. %s is the ink that erases it. The command will be: "%s"
I am the oldest fire. %s obeys neither kings nor gods — only you, if you are worthy. The command will be: "%s"
Cold is patient and beautiful. %s dances, and the world stops to watch. The command will be: "%s"
I am not one blade: I am a thousand. When %s scatters, no shield will be enough. The command will be: "%s"
Each of my cuts weighs twice the last. No one stands before %s for long. When the time comes, the command will be: "%s"
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.named.3: But knowing my name is not mastering me. At rank III you will have to defeat me.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank1.2: I am the blade you carry, %s. Until today you used me as common steel. From now on, fight WITH me.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank1.3: Take the Six Bars of Light: binding is fighting too. Come back when I know who you are — then I'll tell you my name.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank2.1: You have grown. Your Kidō no longer tremble, and I felt every cut.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank2.2: A name is not given: it is HEARD. Close your eyes and tell me what you see inside yourself.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank2.3: Choose. Your soul will shape this world — and me as well.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank3.1: You know my name. But knowing is not enough: %s only obeys those who win.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank3.2: Fight me! If you bring me down, I yield — and the Shikai is yours.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank3_wo: ...Hah. Not bad. Not bad at all.
Shout and I will answer. Use the sword and say: "%s"
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank4.1: The blade is not everything. A true Shinigami also masters Kidō.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank4.2: Destruction and Binding: you already understand both ways. I'll show you the Void Wall.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank4.3: And take this technique with you: a crescent so black that even the sky will want to flee it.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank5.1: So you have reached the last door.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank5.2: Bankai is not a gift. You must materialize me and SUBDUE me. I am %s — and this time I will fight with everything.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank5.3: If you fall, you return to the plaza. If you win... we will never be two again.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank5_wo: ...You subdued me. So this is what it means to be one.
Call my true name at the right moment: %s. In the Grimoire, put Supreme Transformation → Bankai in your G spell.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.spar.1: You want to train, %s? Then raise your blade. I won't go easy just because we share a soul.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.shinigami.spar_won: Good training. Take this experience with you.
Good training... but I've taught you all I could for today. Come back tomorrow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kido_bakudo_61.desc: EFFECT (Shinigami, Kidō). Six blades of light pin the target at the waist: Rooted for 2.5 s and Stunned for half of that (Extend increases it). Bosses are held for 40% of the time. Minimal damage. Works with any form (White Lightning + Six Bars = bind from afar).
glyph.isekai_mahou.kido_bakudo_81.desc: FORM (Shinigami, Kidō). Raises a wall of golden Reiatsu 2.5 blocks ahead (5 wide, +2 per Expand; 3.5 tall) for 8 s (Extend increases it). Dissolves enemy projectiles, blocks enemies from passing and, if the spell has effects, applies them once per second to whoever touches it (cost as pulses, moderated). Works without effects. Up to 3 walls per caster.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kido_hado_31.desc: FORM (Shinigami, Kidō). A sphere of red Reiatsu that flies straight and bursts on the first hit, applying the effects in an area (radius 2.5; Expand increases it). Does not break blocks. Split fires more spheres in a fan (cost per copy). Counts as Kidō. Can be stage 2+.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kido_hado_4.desc: FORM (Shinigami, Kidō). A white lightning bolt fired from the fingertip, instant, up to 26 blocks (+4 per Accelerate). Hits the first enemy in line (+1 per Pierce) and stops at blocks (Phantom passes through). Split fires extra bolts in a fan (cost per copy). Counts as Kidō. Can be stage 2+.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kido_hado_90.desc: FORM (Kidō, rank IV + 200 Kidō). After a 1.5 s incantation, a BLACK COFFIN rises around the targeted enemy (up to 24 blocks, +4 per Accelerate): it traps everyone inside (Rooted + Stunned; bosses 1/3 of the time), four volleys of dark spears apply the effects and at the end the coffin CRUSHES (own damage 7 + effects). Expand widens the coffin. Cost: 4 copies (the spears).
glyph.isekai_mahou.shikai_flame.desc: EFFECT (Shinigami, Flame archetype). The oldest fire: strong damage, stacking Burning and a fire that is hard to put out. Amplify stacks faster.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shikai_frost.desc: EFFECT (Shinigami, Frost archetype). The ice dance: damage and stacking Chilled; at the fifth stack the target freezes. Extend lengthens the cold.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shikai_petals.desc: EFFECT (Shinigami, Petals archetype). A thousand cutting petals: damage and stacking Bleeding (damage over time that doubles while the target moves). Amplify opens deeper wounds; Extend makes it bleed longer.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shikai_weight.desc: EFFECT (Shinigami, Weight archetype). Light damage and every hit DOUBLES the target's weight (×2, ×4, ×8, ×16, ×32): growing slowness, fatigue, then pinned to the ground and Exposed. Amplify raises it 2 at a time; the weight fades if you stop hitting.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shikai_white_brush.de: EFFECT (Shinigami, Brush archetype). The ink "erases the name": Silenced (no spells or abilities), Weakness II and loses every beneficial effect; monsters forget who they were attacking. After the ink fades the target is immune to the brush for 8 s. Bosses resist (1/3 of the time).
glyph.isekai_mahou.shinigami_cero.desc: FORM (Shinigami, defeat the Inner Hollow). Charges for 0.7 s and fires a crimson beam with a black core in a straight line (32 blocks, +4 per Accelerate) that pierces EVERY enemy (own damage 4 + effects) and explodes at the end. Expand thickens it; Phantom goes through blocks. Full power only with the Hollow Mask or in Vasto Lorde; without it the power leaks (60%%, damage 2). Can be a spell stage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shinigami_shunpo.desc: FORM (Shinigami). You vanish and reappear up to 9 blocks ahead (+3 per Expand), stopping before walls. Aiming at an enemy in range, you reappear BEHIND it and apply the effects to it. Without effects it is just the dash. Leaves an afterimage and resets fall damage. Always 1 copy (Split does not multiply it).
glyph.isekai_mahou.shinigami_vasto_lorde: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Shinigami; rank V + tamed Hollow + 30 Mask uses). Goes inside the Supreme Transformation (G key). For 25 s the Hollow takes over: a mask with long horns and a hole in the chest, Strength III, Resistance II, Speed II, 3%% health regeneration per second, hits ×1.5, Shinigami techniques +50%%, one pulse per second (radius 6, +Expand on the body) with the effects and a GIANT CERO every 5 s. RISKY: when it ends the body collapses — health drops to 25%%, Weakness II, Slowness, Fatigue and Vigor emptied.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shinigami_visored.des: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Shinigami, defeat the Inner Hollow). Goes inside the Transformation (any key): Transformation → Hollow Mask → effects. Your hand sweeps across your face and the white mask with crimson stripes forms for 20 s (+5 s every 10 uses, up to 45 s; Extend on the body increases it): Shinigami techniques +30%% power, Strength I, Speed I, full-power Cero, Black Getsuga and the DOUBLE VOICE (what you say echoes distorted). Putting on the mask releases a Reiatsu burst that applies the effects within 4 blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_bankai.desc: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Shinigami). Goes inside the Supreme Transformation (G key): Supreme Transformation → Bankai → effects. The zanpakutō's final release for 20 s (Extend on the body increases it): Strength II, Resistance I, Speed II and Jump; sword hits ×1.6 with an empowered signature and, every second, a pulse in a radius of 10 (+Expand on the body) applies the spell's effects and the archetype's field to every enemy (Weight: crushing gravity; Petals: storm of blades; Frost: freezing field; Flame: inferno; Brush: ink domain). When it ends: Weakness and Fatigue.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_getsuga.des: FORM (Shinigami, rank IV). The blade releases its Reiatsu as a HUGE diagonal CRESCENT MOON (5 blocks, +2 per Expand; Charge makes it 25%% bigger) that flies ~40 blocks and cuts EVERY enemy in its path with its own damage (5) on top of the effects. During Bankai or with the Hollow Mask it becomes the BLACK GETSUGA TENSHŌ: black with a crimson rim, 40%% wider, damage 7 and +25%% power. Split = fan. Can be a spell stage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_moon_fang.d: FORM (Shinigami). The blade releases its Reiatsu as a wide crescent (3 blocks; +1 per Expand) that flies ~28 blocks and cuts EVERY enemy in its path, each one once. Split fires more crescents in a fan (cost per copy). Takes the archetype's color; during Bankai it turns black with a crimson edge and 50% wider. Can be stage 2+.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_mugetsu.des: G FORM (Shinigami, LAST-RESORT ultimate; rank V + 150 Getsuga + 6 bosses → the spirit's final lesson). You rise, the world sinks into total darkness (Darkness on players, Blindness and Slowness on enemies within 40 blocks) and 1 s later an 18-block wall of darkness (+2 per Expand) cuts EVERYTHING for ~65 blocks, through blocks: own damage 30 + the effects. THE PRICE: 10 minutes WITHOUT SPIRITUAL POWER (no Shinigami techniques, no Shikai/Bankai, Vigor almost frozen).
glyph.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_zanjutsu.de: FORM (Shinigami). The art of the sword: a 140° arc slash in front of you (radius 3.2; +1 per Expand; +0.8 while holding the zanpakutō) that applies the effects to every enemy in the arc, with a short step forward. Each Split adds one more follow-up slash (cost per copy). 15% stronger with the zanpakutō in hand. Can be stage 2+.
item.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_t4: Zanpakutō IV: Blade of the Awakened Soul
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bankai_en: The Bankai ended. Your body pays the price (Weakness and Fatigue).
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bankai_le: Bankai learned: %s! In the Grimoire, put Supreme Transformation → Bankai in your G spell.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.blade_kep: Your zanpakutō came back with you.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.blade_ret: This blade belongs to another soul: it returned to its owner.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.choose_no: Talk to the spirit before choosing.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.cmd_arche: Unknown archetype (weight, petals, frost, flame, brush).
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.inner_arr: You are in your Inner World. %s waits in the plaza. Meditate again to return.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.inner_lef: Your soul returned to your body.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.inner_mis: The Inner World does not exist in this world (missing dimension).
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.jinzen_gr: Meditate with your feet on the ground.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.jinzen_hi: Sneak and use the zanpakutō (or the tab button) to meditate.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.jinzen_re: Jinzen: stay still for your soul to return to your body...
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.jinzen_st: Jinzen: stay still for your soul to descend into the Inner World...
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.jinzen_tr: You cannot leave in the middle of a trial!
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.not_shini: Only a Shinigami can hear this blade.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.outfit_eq: Equipped right away (the old pieces went to your inventory).
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.outfit_in: The new pieces went to your inventory.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.petals_ch: Chire! — hold USE and aim: the petals follow your gaze. Release to reform the blade.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.petals_go: Gōkei! The sphere of petals closes in.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.petals_se: Senkei: a thousand swords surround the battlefield.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.powerless: Mugetsu consumed all your spiritual power. You will be powerless for %s minutes.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank_read: Rank %s of the Path of the Zanpakutō is ready! Meditate and talk to %s in the Inner World.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank_up: Path of the Zanpakutō — rank %s: %s! +%s XP
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.rank_up_a: %s reached "%s" on the Path of the Zanpakutō!
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.shikai_co: The blade is still resting: %s s
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.shikai_en: The Shikai ended: the blade went back to sleep.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.shikai_le: Shikai unlocked! Use the zanpakutō and shout: "%s"
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.shikai_lo: The Shikai only comes at rank III of the Path of the Zanpakutō.
The blade has no name yet. Meditate and talk to the spirit.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.status_re: Rank %s is ready! Meditate and talk to the spirit.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_lear: New Shinigami technique: %s! Put it together in the Grimoire.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.trial_fai: You lost the trial. Recover and try again!
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.trial_sta: Shikai trial: defeat %s! It yields below 10%% health.
Bankai trial: subdue the materialized %s — 3 phases!
The INNER HOLLOW has taken %s! Defeat it — it yields below 10%% health.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.vasto_bus: The Hollow has already taken your body.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.vasto_end: The Hollow recedes... your body collapses.
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.vasto_sho: %s: "..." — the Hollow fully awakens: VASTO LORDE!
message.isekai_mahou.shinigami.welcome: You are a Shinigami! The zanpakutō is bound to your soul. Sneak and use the sword to meditate (Jinzen) and descend into the Inner World. See the Shinigami tab in the menu (B).
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bonus.1: Spiritual regeneration: while meditating (sneaking and still) you heal, recover Vigor and shake off bad effects.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bonus.2: Reiatsu in the blade: every zanpakutō hit restores 2% Vigor; released, ×1.25 (Shikai) / ×1.6 (Bankai) damage plus the archetype's signature.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bonus.4: Path of the Zanpakutō: spells with a Shinigami glyph gain +4% power per rank.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bonus.5: Soul-bound blade: the zanpakutō is not dropped on death and flies back when thrown away.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.choose_sub: Choose your Shikai archetype. Your soul will shape the Inner World.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.go_fight: Ready! Meditate and defeat the spirit in the Inner World.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.go_talk: Ready! Meditate and talk to the spirit in the Inner World.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.1: Sneak and use the zanpakutō to meditate (Jinzen): your soul descends into the Inner World, where the sword spirit waits.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.2: Each rank needs a Circle and feats (kills, Kidō, cuts, releases, bosses) and is DONE by talking to the spirit.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.3: Rank II: the spirit says its name and you choose the Shikai archetype — the Inner World's landscape changes.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.4: Ranks III and V end in a fight: win (it yields below 10%). Losing just sends you back to the plaza.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.5: Every technique is a glyph: build Zanjutsu, Shunpo, Kidō and the archetype signature in the Grimoire with the rest of the system.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.guide.6: Sneak + click the spirit (rank III+) = sparring: a risk-free fight, with XP once per day.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.keep_going: Complete the feats above to advance.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.meditate_t: Stay still for 5 s for your soul to descend into the Inner World (sneak + use the zanpakutō works too).
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.no_archety: No archetype: the spirit speaks its name at rank II.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.not_shinig: You are not a Shinigami: these techniques only come through a Lesson from a Shinigami.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_how.g: Comes on its own at rank IV. During Bankai or with the mask it becomes the Black Getsuga.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_how.h: Comes on its own at rank IV after casting 200 Kidō.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_how.m: The final lesson: at rank V, with 150 Getsuga and 6 bosses, talk to the spirit in the Inner World. A last-resort G form.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_how.v: Comes on its own at rank V, with the Hollow tamed and 30 Mask uses. A risky G form.
In the Inner World, talk to the spirit: the INNER HOLLOW takes its place. Defeat it to learn the Hollow Mask and the Cero.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_tip.g: Getsuga Tenshō: assemble it in the Grimoire with a damage effect (e.g. Arcane Damage) — Charge makes it bigger.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_tip.h: Kurohitsugi: aim at an enemy; the spears repeat the effects 4 times before the crush.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_tip.m: Mugetsu: put it in your G spell and use it only when there is no other way — then 10 minutes powerless.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.tech_tip.v: Vasto Lorde: put it in the Supreme Transformation (G key). Careful — when it ends, your body collapses.
Hollow Mask and Cero learned! Put on the mask before Cero and Getsuga for full power.
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.title: Path of the Zanpakutō
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.unlocked.0: Sealed blade (the Shikai comes at rank III).
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.unlocked.1: Shikai unlocked: use the sword to shout the command. (Bankai at rank V)
screen.isekai_mahou.shinigami.unlocked.2: Shikai and Bankai unlocked: put Supreme Transformation → Bankai in your G spell.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.brush.b: Ink domain: every second, everyone around has their name erased (bosses resist).
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.brush.d: A brush-blade: its black ink "erases the name" of what it touches — and what has no name cannot fight.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.brush.s: The ink erases the name: Silenced (no spells), Weakness and loses its good effects; then immune to the brush for 8 s.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.flame.b: Inferno: everything around burns without stopping while the Bankai lasts.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.flame.d: The oldest fire of all, which obeys no one but you and turns everything to ash.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.flame.s: Every cut stacks Burning and lights a fire that is hard to put out.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.frost.b: Freezing field: the cold takes the whole radius and freezes whoever stays in it.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.frost.d: The ice dance: every movement of the blade makes the air colder and stiller.
shinigami.isekai_mahou.archetype.frost.s: Every cut stacks Chilled; at the fifth stack the target freezes.
Giant blades sink into the ground and become an ocean of petals that cuts everyone around. Hold use: a torrent that follows your aim; release while aiming at an enemy: Gōkei; sneak + use: Senkei, the ring of a thousand swords.
The blade scatters into a thousand cutting petals that dance at your command.
Every cut opens wounds: stacking Bleeding. HOLD use: the blade becomes a swarm of petals that follows your aim and cuts everything in its path.
Crushing gravity: every second everyone around grows heavier and is dragged to the ground.
A patient blade: every cut makes the opponent heavier, until they can no longer stand.
Every cut DOUBLES the target's weight (×2 → ×32): growing slowness, fatigue, then pinned to the ground and exposed.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shinigami_outfit.gi: Given for free to Shinigami at Circle %s.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shinigami_outfit.mo: Hold Shift to see the outfit bonuses
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shinigami_outfit.se: Full outfit: %s defense · +%s Vigor · +%s%% regen · +%s%% speed · +%s%% melee damage
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shinigami_outfit_fl: The squad armband weighs on the arm — and on the responsibilities.
Black kimono and white sash: the uniform of someone fresh out of the Academy.
A long, tattered coat lined in crimson. The Bankai's Reiatsu seeps through the seams.
The white haori bearing the squad emblem. Few have the right to wear it.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shinigami_spirit_ca: Restores 30% of your resource (Shinigami; other classes 15%), heals a little and grants Speed. 30 s cooldown.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto.meditate: Sneak + use: meditate (Jinzen) and descend into the Inner World
tooltip.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto.nameless: The blade has not spoken its name yet...
tooltip.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto.soul: Soul-bound: not dropped on death and flies back to its owner
tooltip.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto.use: Use: release the Shikai (rank III) · tap again: seal it · Petals: HOLD use to control the swarm
